system.description:
Whether from a background in sports or raw talent, you excel at physical exertion: throwing, sprinting, climbing, jumping and swimming — the last especially useful to vampires, who do not naturally float. Feats directly tied to combat fall under Brawl, Dodge or Melee, but thrown weapons rely on Athletics.

Expend Athletics for retests on most forms of raw physical activity: acrobatics, running, climbing, jumping, swimming and throwing. You may focus on something you do especially well.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
